verdict.rationale: Qodo's pricing FAQ states plainly that it does not train models on your code and uses code only to generate reviews; plans also list 'Strict data retention'. Self-managed, on-premises and air-gapped deployment options let teams keep data inside their own infrastructure. Missing for 10: a detailed first-party data-usage or privacy policy beyond one FAQ line, explicit coverage of non-code data (PR chat, ticket context), and independent corroboration.
